facts.fact: The ATDI technology and inclusive incubator in Nampula runs a 45-day pre-incubation programme with a current cohort of seven startups, and has supported 66 startups from four hackathons (33 pre-incubation, 13 incubation, 20 acceleration), while the Tech Hub building is being rehabilitated.
